import tkinter as tk

class Presentation:
    def __init__(self, slides):
        self.slides = slides
        self.current_slide_index = 0
        self.root = tk.Tk()
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(self.root)
        self.canvas.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.show_current_slide()

    def show_current_slide(self):
        slide = self.slides[self.current_slide_index]
        self.canvas.delete(tk.ALL)
        self.canvas.create_text(100, 100, text=slide)

    def next_slide(self):
        if self.current_slide_index < len(self.slides) - 1:
            self.current_slide_index += 1
            self.show_current_slide()

    def previous_slide(self):
        if self.current_slide_index > 0:
            self.current_slide_index -= 1
            self.show_current_slide()

        self.host = host
        self.port = port
        self.server_socket = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self.client_socket = None

            self.server_socket.listen(1)
            print("Transparent proxy started on {}:{}".format(self.host, self.port))

                t = threading.Thread(target=self.handle_client_request)
